message.content:
**Frequency of SNP rs7412 in European populations**

| Population group | Minor‑Allele Frequency (MAF) |
|-------------------|------------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.14–0.16** |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.10–0.12** |

*Sources:*  
- [gnomAD Browser](https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/) – Variant page for *APOE* rs7412 shows MAF ≈ 0.15 among non‑Finnish Europeans and slightly lower (~0.11) in Finns.  
- Literature review of APOE genotype studies in European cohorts consistently reports similar ranges (e.g., 13–17% depending on subpopulation).

These figures represent the proportion of chromosomes carrying the alternative allele at this locus within each reference cohort. Frequencies may vary modestly across specific European ethnic groups but generally fall within the range above.
